title: Unitarian Christianity
altTitles: A Sermon Delivered at the Ordination of Jared Sparks
author: william-ellery-channing
attributionNote: A sermon by William Ellery Channing, a leading early American Unitarian preacher. It is a historical theological statement, not a UUA statement.
description: Channing’s ordination sermon became a landmark statement of American Unitarian theology, arguing for a rational and moral reading of Christianity and against Trinitarian doctrine.
historicalContext: Delivered in Baltimore in 1819, the sermon helped define the emerging Unitarian movement in the United States. Its arguments belong to their own theological and political moment.
availabilityNote: Catalogue record only. Public-domain editions likely exist, but no verified edition is imported in this build.
